# Queryra - AI Search for WordPress & WooCommerce

> Queryra is a WordPress plugin that replaces default keyword search with intent-aware AI semantic search. Built for WooCommerce stores and WordPress sites.

## What It Does

Queryra understands what customers mean, not just what they type. When someone searches "present for my girlfriend", default WooCommerce returns 0 results. Queryra finds gift boxes, perfume sets, and skincare bundles from your catalog.

Key capabilities:
- Semantic AI search trained on YOUR store's products
- Intent-aware: understands price filters ("under $50"), brand exclusions ("not Beats"), and sorting
- WooCommerce integration: indexes titles, descriptions, SKUs, categories, tags, attributes, prices
- Auto-sync on publish, bulk import, batched operations
- Smart context detection: searches products on shop pages, posts elsewhere
- Search analytics with zero-result query tracking
- Works with any WordPress theme
- No OpenAI/ChatGPT API key required

## Pricing

- Free Trial: 14 days, 100 products, 500 searches/month
- Genesis Club (first 100 users): 30 days trial, 200 products, $9.99/mo locked forever
- Pro: from $9.99/month, 500+ products, 5,000+ searches/month
